en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a gently curving street lined with multi‑story townhouses and inns, leading towards a prominent church tower with a clock and spire. The caption at the top in red Gothic-style text reads "Frauenstein i. Erzgeb. Bahnhofstrasse," indicating a view of Bahnhofstrasse in Frauenstein in the Erzgebirge region. German signage on the left façade includes "Gasthaus zum Lindenhof." The printer's imprint and date appear along the bottom edge.
